parts:
I suggest you start with all the references found in the two review papers below.

Further, you can look at the references in the books at: http://www.r-inla.org/books

@article{rue2017bayesian,
    title={Bayesian computing with {INLA}: a review},
    author={Rue, H{\aa}vard and Riebler, Andrea and S{\o}rbye, Sigrunn H and Illian, Janine B and Simpson, Daniel P and Lindgren, Finn K},
    journal={Annual Review of Statistics and Its Application},
    volume={4},
    pages={395--421},
    year={2017},
    publisher={Annual Reviews}
}


@article{bakka2018spatial,
    author = {Bakka, Haakon and Rue, Håvard and Fuglstad, Geir-Arne and Riebler, Andrea and Bolin, David and Illian, Janine and Krainski, Elias and Simpson, Daniel and Lindgren, Finn},
    title = {Spatial modeling with R-INLA: A review},
    journal = {Wiley Interdisciplinary Reviews: Computational Statistics},
    volume = {10},
    number = {6},
    pages = {e1443},
    keywords = {approximate Bayesian inference, Gaussian Markov random fields, Laplace approximations, sparse matrices, spatial statistics, stochastic partial differential equations},
    doi = {10.1002/wics.1443},
    url = {https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/wics.1443},
    eprint = {https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/pdf/10.1002/wics.1443},
    year = {2018}
}
